items.headline: Heat Advisory issued August 14 at 4:46AM AKDT until August 14 at 7:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Temperatures in the lower 80s expected.

* WHERE...City and Borough of Juneau and Eastern Chichagof Island.

* WHEN...Until 7 PM AKDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Individuals not accustomed to these unusually hot
temperatures for this region may experience heat related illnesses.
items.areas: Eastern Chichagof Island; City and Borough of Juneau
items.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids, and check up on elderly and vulnerable
relatives and neighbors.

items.headline: Heat Advisory issued August 14 at 2:45AM AKDT until August 15 at 7:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Hot temperatures as high as 75 to 80 degrees expected.

* WHERE...Interior Seward Peninsula, Lower Kobuk Valley, Noatak
Valley, and Northern Seward Peninsula.

* WHEN...From noon to 7 PM AKDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Individuals not accustomed to these unusually hot
temperatures for this region may experience heat related illnesses.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The warmest temperatures will be during the
afternoon and early evening hours. Temperatures will cool off
through the evening.
items.areas: Noatak Valley; Lower Kobuk Valley; Northern Seward Peninsula; Interior Seward Peninsula
items.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids and check up on elderly and vulnerable
relatives and neighbors.
